title: A Model for Estimating the Economic Effects of Changes in Permitting Requirements: Working Paper 2026-10
summary_raw: CBO describes a structural model for estimating how changes in permitting requirements affect private investment. The framework shows how longer or more uncertain permitting processes increase the user cost of capital and reduce investment.
